title: 俗世凡尘 第9章 藏经阁俗世凡尘 第10章 意外的发现

冬去春来，转眼间已经到了第三个年头。这三年间，陆多福已经学会了温老头医术的八九成本事。剩下的一两成实在晦涩高深，非一朝一夕之功能成就。
按温老头的说法，医术之道，只有学以致用方能至大成。所以近一年来，温老头诊病大都是由陆多福代劳了。除了少数疑难杂症，温老头几乎不过问。毕竟温老头年纪大了，精神是一日不如一日。
“方大叔，这是你的药。这两天还痛吗？要不要再扎两针？”
云隐山附近的小镇上，老方酒坊门前，陆多福将一包药递给老板老方。
“哈哈，不用啦，我好多了，这得多亏小神医你。”老方憨厚地笑了笑，递了两坛酒给陆多福，神秘兮兮地道：“小的这坛是温老喜欢的五加皮。大的这坛是我新酿的十里香，你先拿去给你师父尝尝看，要是他喜欢，我再给你两坛，嘿嘿。”
“方大叔，这……”
老方作了个嘘的手势：“老规矩，天知，地知，你知，我知……”
温老头由于年纪大，轻易不会下山。近一年来，陆多福给越来越多的人看病，解决了不少顽疾。在云隐山一带得了个“陆小神医”的称号。
酒坊老板老方颈椎痛，陆多福给他诊治后大有好转。老方很是高兴，就送酒给陆多福喝。可陆多福不过是个十四岁的孩子，哪里敢喝，生怕让南宫修撞见了受责罚。不过平日里白云溪和南宫月二人不让南宫修喝，南宫修只好让陆多福偷偷给自己准备一些。
看在南宫修怕老婆的份上，陆多福心疼他，就时不时跑来找老方买一些，不过老方怎么可能会要他的钱。白拿人家东西不给钱，陆多福有些过意不去，有空就会来帮帮老方的忙。时间久了，酿酒的本事也学了不少。
自己酿的酒，不知道怎么样。陆多福尝了尝，味道还可以，想来师父肯定喜欢。随后陆多福把大酒坛子藏起来，跑回云药堂将小坛的酒交给温老头，又偷偷配了点解酒的药，散尽身上的酒味后，才敢跑回碧秀峰。
“小福子，你死哪去了？大半天都找不到你。”陆多福正要偷偷溜回房，正巧碰上了要出门的南宫月。
南宫月大陆多福一岁多，十五岁的少女，已经基本发育成型。此刻的她身形高挑，乌黑如云的长发垂肩，如花脸庞上挂着一抹浅笑，一袭杏黄长裙微微摆动，越发显得清丽绝俗，楚楚动人。
陆多福做贼心虚，轻轻地吸了吸鼻子，确定没酒味后，干笑道：“师姐，好久不见，好想你啊。我也没干啥，就去山脚下给方大叔送药了。”
南宫月板着脸道：“瞎说，方大叔那才多远，用得了你去大半天。你这小福子，最近是越来越不老实了，神神秘秘的。快说，是不是偷会哪家姑娘去了。”
陆多福苦着脸道：“哪有，谁家姑娘会跟我私会啊。我真是给方大叔送药去了，不信你去问他。”
“扑哧”，南宫月一笑：“逗你的，别那么认真。走，陪我去趟仙人峰。”
“呃，那个，师姐，我还有点事……”陆多福哪敢跟她去，万一让她发现自己身上有酒味，那可不妙。
“真的？去不去？”南宫月凑了过来，纤纤素手捏住了陆多福的耳朵。

“疼疼疼，我去，我去还不行吗？师姐饶命。”男孩发育比较晚，十四岁的陆多福比十五岁的南宫月矮了整整一个头。香风扑鼻，陆多福一抬头，正好看见南宫月领口一抹雪白，顿觉有点面红耳赤，慌忙别过头去。
“这还差不多。乖，跟师姐去一趟，一会就回来了。”南宫月拉着陆多福，向仙人峰走去。
仙人峰作为主峰，上设议事大厅，祖师祠堂，藏经阁。这些都是门派要地，一直有弟子和长老值守的，不能随便让弟子上去的。只有遇到门派大事，需要通告全宗，才会叫上所有弟子上去。
不过南宫月作为掌门的女儿，自然可以通行无阻。而陆多福是掌门弟子，又跟温老头学了医术，“小神医”之名响彻云隐山，所以就算是门内的长老都得卖他个面子，也就不会有人去为难他。
南宫月一路把陆多福拉上了仙人峰。陆多福年纪不大，却较为早熟，对男女之防比较严，被漂亮师姐拉着，不免有些不好意思。幸好仙人峰上人迹罕至，倒也没什么人撞见。
“嘿，总算上来了。”仙人峰顶，陆多福呼哧呼哧喘着粗气。
眼前是一片开阔的广场，全部用青石地板铺就。广场尽头是同样用石头围起一片高台，作为观礼或者擂台使用。高台背后是三间青瓦房，门头上方写着三个黑色大字“云隐殿”，看起来有些年头了。
进入云隐门三年了，陆多福还是第一次上来。本来的话，云隐门每年至少有那么一两次重要事件，会召集全宗弟子，但是陆多福情况特殊。
云隐门任何人都可以随便收正式弟子，唯有掌门不行。陆多福向南宫修行过拜师礼，当了记名弟子，可后面因为他绝脉的事情，自然不能成为一宗之主的正式弟子。这就导致陆多福的身份比较尴尬，他是南宫修个人的记名弟子，却不能算是正式的云隐门弟子。

Winter turns to spring, and in the blink of an eye it’s the third year. In the past three years, Lu Duofu has learned eighty-nine basic principles of Old Man Wen's medical skills. The remaining one to two percent is really obscure and profound, and cannot be achieved overnight.
According to Mr. Wen, medical skills can only be achieved by applying what you have learned. Therefore, in the past year, Lu Duofu has been doing most of Old Man Wen's diagnosis and treatment. Except for a few difficult and complicated diseases, Old Man Wen hardly cares about anything. After all, Old Man Wen is getting older and his energy is getting worse every day.
"Uncle Fang, this is your medicine. Is it still painful these two days? Do you want two more injections?"
In a small town near Yunyin Mountain, in front of Lao Fang's wine shop, Lu Duofu handed a packet of medicine to the boss, Lao Fang.
"Haha, no need, I'm much better, thanks to you, the little miracle doctor." Old Fang smiled honestly, handed two jars of wine to Lu Duofu, and said mysteriously: "The smaller jar is made of Wujiapi, which Mr. Wen likes. The larger jar is my newly brewed ten-mile incense. You can give it to your master to taste first. If he likes it, I will give you two more jars, hehe."
"Uncle Fang, this..."
Lao Fang made a shushing gesture: "Old rules, God knows, earth knows, you know, I know..."
Old Man Wen cannot easily go down the mountain because of his old age. In the past year, Lu Duofu has treated more and more people and solved many stubborn diseases. He earned the title of "Little Miracle Doctor Lu" in the Yunyin Mountain area.
Lao Fang, the owner of a wine shop, suffered from cervical spondylosis. After Lu Duofu gave him diagnosis and treatment, he was greatly improved. Lao Fang was very happy and gave Lu Duofu wine to drink. But Lu Duofu was just a fourteen-year-old boy, so he didn't dare to drink for fear of being caught and punished by Nangong Xiu. However, Bai Yunxi and Nangong Yue would not let Nangong Xiu drink on weekdays, so Nangong Xiu had to ask Lu Duofu to secretly prepare some for him.
Seeing that Nangong Xiu was afraid of his wife, Lu Duofu felt sorry for him, so he would come to Lao Fang to buy some from time to time, but how could Lao Fang ask for his money. Lu Duofu felt a little sorry for taking other people's things for free without paying for them, so he came to help Lao Fang when he had time. As time went by, I learned a lot about wine making.
I made my own wine, I don’t know how it tastes. Lu Duofu tasted it and found that it tasted pretty good. He thought Master would like it. Then Lu Duofu hid the big wine jar, ran back to Yunyao Hall, handed the small jar of wine to Old Man Wen, and secretly mixed some hangover medicine. Only after the smell of alcohol was gone from his body did he dare to run back to Bixiu Peak.
"Xiao Fuzi, where did you die? I couldn't find you for a long time." Lu Duofu was about to sneak back to the room when he happened to meet Nangong Yue who was about to go out.
Nangong Yue Dafu is more than a year old, and the fifteen-year-old girl has basically developed into shape. At this moment, she was tall and tall, with long black hair hanging down her shoulders, a smile on her flowery face, and an apricot yellow dress that swayed slightly, making her look more and more beautiful and charming.
Lu Duofu felt guilty and sniffed gently. After making sure there was no alcohol smell, he smiled dryly and said, "Senior sister, long time no see. I miss you so much. I didn't do anything, so I went to the foot of the mountain to deliver medicine to Uncle Fang."
Nangong Yue said with a straight face: "Nonsense, Uncle Fang is only that far away, it will take you a long time to go there. You little lucky boy, you have become more and more dishonest and mysterious recently. Tell me, have you cheated on some girl?"
Lu Duofu said with a grimace: "No way, some girl would have a private meeting with me. I really sent medicine to Uncle Fang. If you don't believe me, ask him."
"Puch", Nangong Yue smiled: "I'm teasing you, don't be so serious. Come on, accompany me to the Immortal Peak."
"Uh, um, senior sister, I have something else to do..." How dare Lu Duofu go with her? It would be bad if she found out that he smelled of alcohol.
"Really? Are you going?" Nangong Yue came over and pinched Lu Duofu's ears with her delicate hands.
"It hurts, it hurts. I'm going, can't I go? Senior sister, please forgive me." Boys develop relatively late. Fourteen-year-old Lu Duofu is a whole head shorter than fifteen-year-old Nangong Yue. fragrantThe wind blew into his nose. When Lu Duofu raised his head, he saw a touch of snow-white on Nangong Yue's collar. He suddenly felt a little red and looked away hurriedly.
"That's pretty much it. Be good, go with senior sister and you'll be back soon." Nangong Yue pulled Lu Duofu and walked towards Immortal Peak.
Immortal Peak is the main peak, with a meeting hall, ancestral hall, and Buddhist scriptures pavilion on it. These are important places for the sect and are always guarded by disciples and elders. Disciples cannot be allowed to go up casually. Only when there is an important event in the sect that needs to be notified to the whole sect, all the disciples will be called on.
But Nangong Yue, as the daughter of the head of the family, can naturally pass through without any hindrance. Lu Duofu is the disciple of the head of the sect, and he also learned medical skills from Old Man Wen. His reputation as the "Little Miracle Doctor" resounds throughout Yunyin Mountain, so even the elders in the sect have to give him face, so no one will embarrass him.
Nangong Yue pulled Lu Duofu all the way to Immortal Peak. Lu Duofu is not very old, but he is relatively precocious, and he is very guarded against men and women. He is a little embarrassed to be pulled by the beautiful senior sister. Fortunately, there are few people on Immortal Peak, so no one bumps into him.
"Hey, we're finally here." At the top of Immortal Peak, Lu Duofu gasped for breath.
In front of you is an open square, all paved with bluestone floors. At the end of the square is a high platform also surrounded by stones, which can be used as a viewing ceremony or a competition platform. Behind the high platform are three blue-tiled rooms, with three large black characters "Yunyin Hall" written above the door, which looks a bit old.
Three years after entering Yunyinmen, this is the first time for Lu Duofu to come up. Originally, the Yunyin Sect would have summoned all the disciples for at least one or two important events every year, but Lu Duofu was in a special situation.
Anyone in the Yunyin Sect can accept formal disciples at will, except the leader. Lu Duofu went through the apprenticeship ceremony with Nangong and became a registered disciple. However, because of his broken bloodline, he naturally could not become a formal disciple of the leader of the sect. This makes Lu Duofu's identity rather embarrassing. He is Nangong Xiu's personal registered disciple, but he cannot be regarded as an official Yunyin Sect disciple.
